candidate_emergence_pipeline: relevant simulation subsystem changes a normalized condition signal or emits a meaningful event
affected Research Pressure records are updated sparsely without scanning technology nodes
pressure-band crossings, new evidence, matured prerequisites, applicability-trait changes, or scheduled basic-science review query static candidate indexes
candidate node prerequisites, applicability, evidence, explicit pressure gates, and civilization knowledge are evaluated
node may become Rumored, Hypothesized, or Investigable depending on information quality and node rules
minimum Effective Research Labs and available directed-program capacity are checked only when starting a directed project
RP then advances the active project toward demonstration/engineering/maturity

event_classes.pressure_band_crossed: A known pressure crosses a meaningful configured band and wakes only nodes indexed to that pressure.
event_classes.evidence_acquired: A new evidence instance wakes only nodes indexed to its evidence type.
event_classes.prerequisite_matured: A matured node wakes only direct child possibilities indexed by prerequisite ID.
event_classes.applicability_changed: A gained/lost mutable trait or changed population biochemical context wakes only nodes indexed to that trait/context.
event_classes.basic_science_review: Low-frequency review samples possibilities reachable through known fields without requiring practical pressure.
event_classes.foreign_capability_observed: Legitimate sensor/intelligence evidence can create pressure and/or evidence without revealing hidden implementation details.
